authorization: User explicitly requested T5 data construction, then reuse/download to DataP and upload to server. Existing full image archive found, so no download needed.
source: Existing user-authorized PadChest-GR reports and master table
inclusion: All rows with an explicit prior image and one supported progression category; join label/progression to the original report. No method output used.
canonicalization: Merge identical same-pair/finding binary-presence tasks, preserve source row bindings and progression categories; exclude conflicting binary references or explicit patient/date conflicts. Do not force paper counts.
time_and_patient_evidence: Cross-check both dates and patient IDs when prior metadata exists; otherwise retain the explicit PreviousStudy link as source-linked, without claiming independent verification.
outputs: four prior-only FIT views per case
image_policy: Use split ZIPs as a virtual seekable archive; no concatenated copy, no full extraction, preserve original bit depth. ZIP CRC is checked by the library while reading selected images; no full-archive re-test or extra hashes.
transfer_policy: Upload all37 already-downloaded main volumes, then only required T5 images/manifests. Keep raw data and patient linkage private.
qualification: Base wrong eligibility and model input preprocessing admission remain pending; dataset build is not a T5 experiment result.

clock.scope: T5 dataset construction and transfer; no model/Judge calls; read-only inventory preceded materialization
